# paginate

> Fast pagination, filtering, sorting, and search with one Rust core (`paginate-core`) and native Python (`pypaginate`) and TypeScript (`@cyblow/paginate`) packages that return byte-for-byte identical results, including byte-identical keyset cursors. The packages are thin, typed adapters over the engine; algorithms (20 filter operators, stable null-aware multi-key sort, ranked trigram-fuzzy search, the cursor codec, pagination math) live once in Rust.

Key facts:
- The native engine ships inside the Python wheel and the npm package — no Rust toolchain needed.
- Operators, sort directions, and search modes are plain strings ("gte", "desc", "contains", "fuzzy").
- Two pagination models: offset (page/limit) and keyset (cursor); cursors are portable across languages.
- Integrations: SQLAlchemy, Django, FastAPI (Python); Express, Prisma, Drizzle (TypeScript).

## General

- [Overview](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/): the documentation hub.
- [Why paginate?](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/general/why): the problem it solves and when to use it.
- [Choosing a package](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/general/choosing-a-package): which install fits your stack.
- [Architecture](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/general/architecture): fat core, thin adapters; the Value boundary; marshalling.
- [Cross-language parity](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/general/parity): why results and cursors match exactly.
- [Pagination models](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/general/pagination-models): offset vs. keyset (cursor).
- [Cursors](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/general/cursors): the portable, typed wire format.
- [Filtering & operators](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/general/filtering): the 20 operators and boolean groups.
- [Sorting semantics](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/general/sorting): stability, direction, null placement.
- [Search & ranking](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/general/search): match modes, trigram fuzzy scoring, weights.
- [FAQ](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/general/faq): common questions.

## Python (pypaginate)

- [Installation](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/python/installation): `pip install pypaginate` and extras.
- [Quickstart](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/python/quickstart): paginate, filter, sort, search, Dataset.
- [Filtering](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/python/filtering): `filter`, `FilterSpec`, `And`/`Or`.
- [Sorting](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/python/sorting): `sort`, `SortSpec`, multi-key, nulls.
- [Search](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/python/search): `search`, `SearchSpec`, fuzzy, weights.
- [Pagination](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/python/pagination): offset, keyset, the resident Dataset.
- [SQLAlchemy](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/python/integrations/sqlalchemy): sync + async, offset + keyset.
- [Django](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/python/integrations/django): QuerySet pagination.
- [FastAPI](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/python/integrations/fastapi): Annotated dependencies.

## JavaScript / TypeScript (@cyblow/paginate)

- [Installation](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/typescript/installation): `npm i @cyblow/paginate`.
- [Quickstart](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/typescript/quickstart): paginate, filter, sort, search, Dataset.
- [Filtering](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/typescript/filtering): `filter`, plain-object specs, `And`/`Or`.
- [Sorting](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/typescript/sorting): `sort`, multi-key, nulls.
- [Search](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/typescript/search): `search`, fuzzy, weights.
- [Pagination](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/typescript/pagination): offset, keyset, the cursor codec, Dataset.
- [Express](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/typescript/integrations/express): parse request params.
- [Prisma](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/typescript/integrations/prisma): offset + keyset where-fragments.
- [Drizzle](https://cyblow.github.io/paginate/docs/typescript/integrations/drizzle): keyset conditions with injected operators.
